name: claude-desk-neighbours
description: Small Claude Code mods that sit under your prompt: flag unanswered questions, show your work, start the next task fresh and learn from each session.

plugins.name: your-serve
plugins.description: 🎾 A button that has Claude ask you what it needs, one question at a time, in its own question picker.

plugins.name: show-and-tell
plugins.description: 📸 Shows you the pictures: a thumbnail the moment you paste one, and /gallery of every image you and Claude passed around this session.

plugins.name: whats-next
plugins.description: ⏭️ When a session gets long, writes a self-contained briefing for the next task, lets you review it, and starts it in a fresh context.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: 🪞 A button that has Claude look back over the session and update its memory, CLAUDE.md, docs and skills with what's worth keeping.
